note: Set B invents or misreads several airfoil names ("FFA-W3-3", "FFA-W3-2", "SNL-FFA") and binds axis-tick values (1.0, 0.0, -1.0, 20, 15) to them as if they were curve data, producing about a dozen unsupported claims. Set A keeps the correct legend entities and Reynolds numbers and gives plausible curve readings (e.g., FFA-W3-211 max cl/cd ~120, FFA-W3-360 max cl/cd ~75). A does contain a few internally inconsistent or overstated values (SNL-FFA-W3-500 max cl/cd 110 and cd 0.08 at cl=1.5, FFA-W3-360 max cl/cd 95, cl=2.0 at 20 deg), and some quotes only cite legend text rather than the plotted value. Overall A is clearly the more faithful set.
